AGENTS

Source: AGENTS.md

Purpose

This file is the execution playbook for humans and coding agents who need to add or extend rule packs quickly in aRtifacts.

Package Boundary

  • aRtifacts is the topology-first, domain-neutral core.
  • aRtifacts.clinical holds trial-specific semantics and implementation-guide content.
  • Do not add SDTM/ADaM or other clinical semantics to aRtifacts core APIs, vignettes, or starter packs.

Source Of Truth In This Repo

  • Topology dispatch and registry: R/topology_engine.R
  • Topology decision mapping: R/topology_decision.R
  • Core classes and constructors: R/classes.R, R/topology_classes.R
  • Topology packs: R/topology_rules_schema.R, R/topology_rules_a1.R, R/topology_rules_a2.R, R/topology_rules_a3.R, R/topology_rules_a4.R, R/topology_rules_a5.R, R/topology_rules_a6.R, R/topology_rules_a7.R
  • Rule-builder scaffold pipeline: R/rule_builder_spec.R, R/rule_builder_render.R, R/rule_builder_guided_helpers.R, R/rule_builder_launcher.R
  • Vignette flow and payload contracts: vignettes/topology-a0-a7.Rmd, vignettes/add-rule-pack.Rmd, vignettes/getting-started.Rmd

Instant Rule-Pack Construction Protocol

When asked to “build a rule pack”, run this exact sequence:

  1. Resolve topology using choose_topology(is_longitudinal, n_domains, level) or the A0-A7 decision flow in vignettes/topology-a0-a7.Rmd.
  2. Pick the smallest payload topology that can express the check.
  3. Create one rule constructor per file in R/rule_<family>_<id>_<slug>.R.
  4. Return a CoreRule via new_rule(...) with stable ID, metadata, and topology-correct fn signature.
  5. Wire the constructor into the matching pack_topology_a*() in the matching R/topology_rules_*.R file.
  6. Add or update a focused tests/testthat/test-rule_<family>_<id>_<slug>.R.
  7. Run targeted pack/catalog/dispatch tests before finishing.

Topology Dispatch Contract (Must Match Exactly)

Topology Rule shape fn signature used by run_rules()
A0 single-cut schema/snapshot fn(domain, context, rule) or fn(context, rule)
A1 single-cut single-domain record fn(data, context, rule)
A2 single-cut single-domain aggregate fn(data, context, rule)
A3 single-cut cross-domain relational fn(domains, context, rule)
A4 single-cut cross-domain aggregate fn(domains, context, rule)
A5 longitudinal single-domain record fn(previous, current, context, rule)
A6 longitudinal single-domain aggregate fn(previous, current, context, rule)
A7 longitudinal cross-domain fn(previous, current, context, rule)

run_rules() skips a rule when required domains are missing. Rule functions must be deterministic, side-effect free, and return a data.frame (or empty data.frame()).

Core Object Contract

  • Use these classes: DomainSnapshot, ArtifactSnapshot, RuleContext, CoreRule, IdentitySpec, MatchSpec, DeltaSpec.
  • For A1/A2/A5/A6, new_rule() requires domain.
  • For A3/A4/A7, new_rule() requires domains with at least two names.
  • Keep IDs stable and semantic; do not change behavior under an existing ID.
  • Core starter IDs follow ^[A-Z]+-[0-9]{3}$ (for example, REL-004, SNAP-011).

File And Naming Conventions

  • One constructor per file.
  • File pattern: R/rule_<family>_<id>_<slug>.R
  • Constructor pattern: rule_<family>_<id>_<slug>()
  • Family prefixes in core: SCH, ID, TMP, DE, GRP, REL, AGG, SNAP, HYB.
  • One pack file per topology: R/topology_rules_<topology>.R (A0 is in R/topology_rules_schema.R).
  • Each pack file exports both pack_topology_a*() and register_topology_a*().

Wiring Contract For Starter Packs

  • A0 lives in pack_topology_a0(domain) and returns SCH-001..003.
  • A1 lives in pack_topology_a1(...) and always includes ID-001, with optional TMP-* and DE-* by args.
  • A2 lives in pack_topology_a2(...) and includes ID-002..004, GRP-001..004, plus optional GRP-005.
  • A3/A4/A5/A6/A7 each return fixed starter lists from their topology file.
  • Keep rule order deterministic in each pack list.
  • Keep registry helpers thin wrappers around pack_topology_a*() + register_rule().

Fast Scaffold Paths (Use These First)

Use one of these two paths to construct pack scaffolds instantly.

Path 1: Rule Builder API

  1. Build normalized spec with build_rule_pack_spec(pack = ..., rules = ...).
  2. Generate R scaffold with render_rule_pack_scaffold(spec).
  3. Generate handoff bundle with render_rule_agent_prompt_bundle(spec).
  4. Optional interactive funnel: launch_rule_builder(output_dir = getwd(), dry_run = TRUE).
  5. Expected generated artifacts (timestamped folder): rule-pack.spec.yaml, rule_pack_<slug>.R, agent_prompt_rule_pack_<slug>.md.

Path 2: Static Templates

  • Use inst/templates/rule-pack-template.R.
  • Use inst/templates/topology-rule-template-a0.R through inst/templates/topology-rule-template-a7.R.
  • Use inst/templates/template-rule-pack-test.R for a quick test skeleton.

Testing Gates (Definition Of Done)

Always run targeted tests that prove pack wiring and catalog coherence.

  1. New or changed rule tests: tests/testthat/test-rule_*.R for touched rules.
  2. Dispatch and pack behavior: tests/testthat/test-topology-engine.R.
  3. Constructor coverage: tests/testthat/test-topology-constructors.R.
  4. Pack coverage and size expectations: tests/testthat/test-core-rule-coverage.R.
  5. Registry behavior: tests/testthat/test-topology-registerers-edge.R, tests/testthat/test-registry-edge.R.
  6. Catalog alignment: tests/testthat/test-rule-catalog-core.R.
  7. Builder/scaffold changes: tests/testthat/test-rule-builder-*.R.

If you add or remove starter rules in pack functions, update expectations in coverage tests accordingly.

Catalog And Registry Notes

  • rule_catalog_core() is computed dynamically from pack_topology_a0() to pack_topology_a7().
  • No data-raw regeneration is required for the current catalog implementation.
  • pack_topology_all() only returns rules currently registered through registry APIs.

Documentation Rules

  • Keep docs aligned to exported APIs in NAMESPACE.
  • Public usage updates should be reflected in vignettes when behavior changes.
  • Prefer compare_flag_states() for longitudinal finding comparisons.
  • Avoid references to removed legacy modules/wrappers.

Agent Prompting Guidance For This Repo

When a user asks for a new rule pack or rule:

  1. Infer topology with choose_topology() inputs.
  2. Generate constructor skeleton with correct fn signature.
  3. Wire into the right pack_topology_a*() immediately.
  4. Add/update rule test file and relevant topology/catalog coverage tests.
  5. Run targeted tests and report exact pass/fail scope.
  6. Keep edits topology-local and avoid parallel abstractions when existing helpers already fit.

Non-Negotiables

  • Keep one-rule-per-file.
  • Keep rule IDs stable.
  • Do not reintroduce compatibility aliases unless explicitly requested.
  • Prefer extending existing .topology_* helpers over duplicating utility logic.
